actors.name: Ashvale University annual-fund caller
actors.private_context: The caller is assigned to phone alumna Dr. Renata Sousa for a first-time donation ask. The caller has a script and a list of alumni to contact, and will make the call during the shift.

actors.name: Dr. Renata Sousa
actors.private_context: Renata is an alumna of Ashvale University who has never donated to the annual fund. She may have her own reasons for not donating previously, and may be open or resistant to a first-time ask.

shared_context: Ashvale University runs an annual-fund campaign. The caller will phone Renata at some point during the month of October 2026. Renata has never donated before. The call is a first-time ask.

starting_events.description: The Ashvale University annual-fund caller begins their shift and has Renata's contact information ready to call.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Renata made a pledge (any amount) to the annual fund before 2026-10-31T21:00:00-03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
